thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: GPU pool 'eu-west-1-pool-3' queue length=1258, 95p latency=8.4s, autoscaler reports 'scale_limit_reached' and API errors from provider. Pager triggered. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/gpu-capacity

brian (oncall): ack, joining. I'll post status here and call for SRE/Infra. ETA 2m. :phone:

charlie (sre): I'm on it. Looking at metrics — autoscaler set to max_nodes=16, pool has used 16. Provider logs show repeated 429/503 when creating instances in eu-west-1. Dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/gpu-pool-eu-west-1

diane (infra): Confirmed. AWS GPu quota in region looks exhausted; provider API returning capacity.errors. Also a surge of background batch jobs tagged 'batch:background' started ~10:02 UTC.

brian (oncall): Immediate mitigations we can do now: 1) Evict low-priority batch jobs, 2) Route latency-sensitive traffic to eu-west-1-pool-1 (standby), 3) Enable fallback_model for chat endpoints. Which two can be done quickly?

charlie (sre): I'm working eviction now. Running eviction job to drain tasks with tag 'batch:background' from pool-3. Command: ```sh
redwoodctl jobs evict --pool eu-west-1-pool-3 --selector 'batch:background' --grace 30s
```

charlie (sre): Also issuing a manual scale-up attempt to a temporary pool with different instance family (if provider allows). ```sh
redwoodctl pools create-temp --from eu-west-1-pool-3 --type p4d-fallback --count 4
```

diane (infra): Provider returned 429 for create-instance calls; trying a different AZ and requesting provider-side quota bump via partner support. Sending escalation ticket to cloud-ops.

emily (support): CS update: several customers reporting 500s and long waits. Top impacted: acct-834, acct-221 (enterprise). I've posted initial status message to status.redwood.com (incident page in progress). Draft note: "We are experiencing degraded inference throughput in EU region; mitigation in progress."

brian (oncall): Good. Alice, can we enable fallback-model config for routes with strict latency? That should reduce per-request tokens and keep customers served.

alice (englead): Yes. Pushing a safe config change: reduce default model to small-gen-v1 for tier=free and tier=prod-latency-sensitive routes. Patch: ```json
{ "route": "/*/generate", "fallback_model": "small-gen-v1", "priority": "latency" }
```
Applying now with canary to 10% traffic.

charlie (sre): Eviction job finished, freed ~6 nodes worth of GPU capacity. Queue length dropped from 1258 -> 420 in 6m. Autoscaler retried but still hitting provider 429s when provisioning more. Routing to pool-1 in progress.

diane (infra): I added a temporary routing policy to send 40% of new requests to eu-west-1-pool-1 (standby). Command: ```sh
redwoodctl routing set --from eu-west-1-pool-3 --to eu-west-1-pool-1 --pct 40
```

emily (support): Customer comms updated: posted to customers A,B,C and open support tickets flagged 'incident:gpu-eu'. Sales/AMs looped in. No SLA breaches expected yet but we're watching.

brian (oncall): Roadmap for next hour: 1) Keep eviction running for remaining background jobs, 2) Maintain routing policy until queue < 100, 3) If provider capacity not recovered in 30m, spin up cross-region routing to eu-central. Assign incident commander? I'll stay as IC for initial response, handoff to @charlie after stabilization.

charlie (sre): Taking over monitoring as IC at 2043210300. I'll coordinate with Diane on provider escalation. Action items logged in incident tracker: https://redwood/incidents/2043210000

diane (infra): Provider responded to escalation: temporary capacity available in AZ eu-west-1b, but creation rate limited. They propose a staged provisioning — we can get 4 instances per 10 minutes. Not ideal but will help draining queue.

charlie (sre): Implemented staged pool creation and increased drain parallelism. Queue now 170. Request to infra: please request permanent quota increase for GPU instance type and ask for capacity reservation option.

alice (englead): Post-incident immediate dev items: 1) Add traffic-aware fallback policies to routes (auto-switch to smaller models under queue/backpressure), 2) Add preemptive eviction rules for low-priority tags when pool queue > 200, 3) Add chaos tests for provider API 429 behavior.

emily (support): PS: Customers on notified list confirming improvement. Thanks team. I'll keep updating status page until resolved.

charlie (sre): At 2043210570 queue < 50, 95p latency back to normal ~200ms for routed traffic, autoscaler stable (no new plan to scale until provider quota confirmed). Marking incident "mitigated". Preparing RCA/postmortem.

brian (oncall): Thanks. Handing final IC role to @charlie for postmortem. Follow-ups: (1) quota request to provider (Diane), (2) add surge runbook and automated eviction (Alice), (3) add cross-region fallback test in staging (Charlie). Please add owners and ETA in the incident tracker. :memo:

incident-bot: Incident mitigated for thread 2043210000 — severity: SEV2 — mitigation at 2043210570. Please file postmortem within 72h and link to incident tracker.

charlie (sre): Creating postmortem doc and scheduling 30m post-incident debrief in 2h. Closing thread here, will post the RCA link when ready. :white_check_mark:
